title: Not Quite Minecraft
description: a vanilla+ modpack that aims to add quality-of-life changes
body:
**Not Quite Minecraft** aims to improve the vanilla exprience while not changing the core of what makes minecraft, well.. minecraft.

why you should download this pack: if you're looking for a modpack to play with your friends or just imrpoves over the vanilla expirence. this could be the one you want



some things in this pack:

ui mods **for example, Blur+. which adds a cool blur effect for the ui.**

visual-effects mods **like wakes. which adds brand new water visual effects to the game.** 

and performance mods **such as sodium, lithium and iris.**



This pack is technically in a beta/test state, and i'm pretty new to this so please send any feedback in my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/aVPu4pxKrs)

Please note that: some of the mods are only compatible with 1.21.1, and some don't have updates above or below. I don’t plan to update the pack for future versions at this time.
